personality_one_liner: A premium, tactile, and responsive offline workspace where warm tones and adaptive surfaces prioritize the user's content.

spacing.rule: Maintain generous breathing room around text and UI components. Use md (12pt) padding inside note cards, and lg (16pt) for screen edges.

dont's: No glass UI. The app relies on tonal surfaces and adaptive cards (Material You style) rather than blur, ensuring fast offline Android performance.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Primary workspace displaying the staggered masonry grid of notes, search, and quick creation tools.

states.loading: Shimmer skeleton matching the masonry grid layout.
states.empty: A warm, abstract minimal illustration of a notebook/desk, paired with a welcoming message ('Your workspace is clear') and a CTA pointing to the FAB.
states.error: Not applicable (100% Offline App). Any database read errors should display a polite 'Unable to load notes' message with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: 1. Top Bar: App logo (left), Checklist shortcut + Settings icon (right). 2. Search Bar: Large, fully rounded (pill), sticky beneath the top bar. 3. Filter Chips: Horizontal scrolling row (All, Favorites, Pinned, Archived, Trash, Folders). 4. Content: 2-column masonry staggered grid (`LazyVerticalStaggeredGrid` equivalent). Cards have `lg` radius, 1pt border, no shadow. 5. FAB: Bottom-right, `pill` shape, floating above the grid, opens an expandable menu.

screens.name: Note Editor
screens.purpose: Distraction-free canvas for creating text, checklists, drawings, or voice notes.
screens.layout: 1. Header: Back button, Note Color Picker icon, Pin, Favorite, Archive, 3-dot menu. 2. Content: Scrollable full-screen text editor (`flex: 1`). 3. Toolbar: Fixed at the bottom above the keyboard, containing text formatting (Bold, Italic, List, Checkbox, Image attachment, Drawing). Title is large display typography; body is highly readable serif/sans.

screens.name: Settings
screens.purpose: App configuration, backup, and security preferences.
screens.layout: Standard single-column scrollable list. Sections: Appearance (Dark/Light mode), Notes, Security (Biometric lock), Backup & Restore, Storage, About. Use `brandTertiary` tinted icons in rounded squares for each setting row.

empty_state_illustration.alt: Minimalist spiral notepad on a clean surface

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE COLORS: The user EXPLICITLY requested specific note colors (Default, Yellow, Green, Blue, Purple, Pink, Orange, Gray). Override the default blue/purple ban for the note card backgrounds ONLY. Use these exact premium hex pairs. LIGHT MODE: Default (surfaceSecondary), Yellow (#FEF9C3), Green (#DCFCE7), Blue (#DBEAFE), Purple (#F3E8FF), Pink (#FCE7F3), Orange (#FFEDD5), Gray (#F3F4F6). DARK MODE: Default (surfaceSecondary), Yellow (#423816), Green (#143C27), Blue (#183354), Purple (#36204F), Pink (#4F1E37), Orange (#4C2915), Gray (#383838).
DARK MODE COLORS (CORE): surface (#181715), surfaceSecondary (#23221F), surfaceTertiary (#2C2A27), surfaceInverse (#FAF9F7). Text should use #E5E3E0 (onSurface). brandPrimary remains #E27429.

MASONRY GRID: Implement a 2-column staggered grid. Cards should NOT have fixed heights; they must adapt to the preview content length. Cards have 1pt border (light: #E5E3E0, dark: #33312E) and NO shadow. Cards should scale to 0.97 on press (150ms animation).
FAB MENU: The main FAB (bottom-right, pill shape, brandPrimary) should expand when tapped to reveal a vertical stack of mini-FABs for Text Note, Checklist, Voice Note, Image Note, and Drawing Note.
BIOMETRIC LOCK: 100% biometric (fingerprint/face). No PIN fallback. Trigger upon app resume or cold start if enabled in settings.

FILTER CHIPS: Render chips as pill-shaped (`radius_tokens.pill`). Inactive state: `surfaceSecondary` background with `border`. Active state: `brandTertiary` background with `brandPrimary` border and text.
OFFLINE ARCHITECTURE: Use a local-first SQLite/WatermelonDB/Realm database. The UI must react instantly via observable queries without spinners.
BOTTOM SHEETS: Use @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the Note Color picker and Folders/Tags management menus. Apply `lg` border radius to the top corners of the sheet.
